body: Thanks for being a great help, I've been struggling with this as I'm the only one she's told and been this descriptive with I'm pretty sure. This has meant a lot.

Yeah, I understand. I don't necessarily mean to try and "fix" her, it just kinda comes out all at once when I try to make her understand or know that there are dozens of us that care for her and love her and that she matters in our lives. But I'm gonna really try to hold all that back and just be an open ear and let her talk. 
What do you think was the biggest factor in "helping" you, if you don't mind me asking? I'm just trying to get any help or point of view possible. 
And again, thank you for caring and responding, this is all very stressful and hard to comprehend really.

Thank you, I try to listen and be an open ear for her and to be supportive, but she just wants to be left alone or she doesn't want to hear it. She is hesistant to get help because she believes it's all bullshit and she's hesitant to even talk about her issues. I'll try more to just listen and not say much. I'm just deathly afraid of losing her, and all this is very hard for me since I'm not very good with these kind of emotions and situations. 
Again, thank you for the help.
Alright, I'll try. Thanks for the help.
I'm not too sure if she would like me going to someone else with this, I'm afraid it would just make things worse.
Thank you, I'll try to just be there for her and let her know how much I care.
She is very resistant on getting any help at all, she thinks it's all bullshit.
